title: Preferred language of Text Extractor not remembered
author: Dobypeti

status.label: strong code-backed design candidate
status.detail: Current Text Extractor code loads PreferredLanguage but leaves selection persistence as an explicit TODO.

next_action.label: Complete persistence design
next_action.reason: Do not expose approve_design until all entry points and tests are specified.

judgment.rationale: The bug has complete reproduction evidence, was reopened after an incorrect duplicate closure, and current Text Extractor code loads PreferredLanguage but leaves selection persistence as an explicit TODO.
evidence: The reporter supplies numbered steps, diagnostics, screenshots, and clarification that the choice lasts only while settings remain open.
A maintainer acknowledged the duplicate closure was mistaken and reopened the issue.
LanguagesComboBox_SelectionChanged contains “TODO: Set the preferred language based upon what was chosen here.”
UserSettings loads PreferredLanguage, but the selection handler does not save it.
judgment.recommended_action: Continue a full implementation-grade design for persisting language changes and synchronizing ComboBox/context-menu state; do not expose approval yet.

issue_context.summary: Text Extractor uses a changed preferred language only while the settings/overlay session remains open; reopening restores the previous language and the dropdown can appear stale.
known_information: The issue provides deterministic steps, screenshots, and a diagnostic archive.
The issue was reopened after a maintainer confirmed the duplicate decision was wrong.
Current code loads PreferredLanguage from settings.
The ComboBox selection handler contains an explicit persistence TODO.
inferences: The missing save/update path is a strong candidate mechanism, but design must verify every language-selection entry point.
issue_context.analysis: The report and code are sufficient for design work without further author questions; remaining work is implementation planning and test coverage.
initial_investigation: Reviewed OCROverlay.xaml.cs population, context-menu, and selection handlers.
Reviewed UserSettings.cs loading and existing Text Extractor language UI tests.

information_gaps.information: All language-selection entry points that must persist the same setting
information_gaps.why_needed: Prevents fixing only the ComboBox while leaving context-menu or Settings UI behavior inconsistent.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Trace Settings UI IPC and overlay context-menu flows during full design.

information_gaps.information: Exact targeted test command and persistence test seam
information_gaps.why_needed: Required for approval-ready verification across process restart.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Identify the PowerOCR test project and add a reopen/restart persistence scenario in the full design.
